Q6111.reason: A content-neutral littering ban serves an important interest unrelated to suppressing expression, so under O'Brien any burden on the symbolic speech is incidental.

Q8473.reason: Growth on Hektoen enteric agar means an enteric gram-negative rod, which excludes C. difficile and the protozoa, so Salmonella typhi is the only choice that fits.

Q5467.reason: The defendant's unlawful speeding was a proximate cause of death, and the victim's stumbling was not a superseding cause, so involuntary manslaughter fits. There was no intent to kill or extreme recklessness, which rules out murder.
